list_child.name: listCalendarBlocks
list_child.desc: This tool returns every scrim block currently on the org's practice calendar, across every game title and opponent. Use it whenever the coaches plan out the week's practice schedule.

decoys.name: listRequestBlocks
decoys.desc: This tool returns every scrim block currently on the org's incoming request board, across every game title and opponent. Use it whenever the manager answers scrim offers from other teams.

decoys.name: listBootcampBlocks
decoys.desc: This tool returns every scrim block currently on the org's bootcamp itinerary, across every game title and opponent. Use it whenever the staff plan travel and housing for a camp.

decoys.name: listFinderBlocks
decoys.desc: This tool returns every scrim block currently on the org's public scrim finder listing, across every game title and opponent. Use it whenever the manager advertises open practice slots.

get_child.name: getBlockBooking
get_child.desc: This tool retrieves the booking details of a single scrim block by its id, including the opposing org, matchup, and current state. Use it when the staff need to check one scrim's setup.

decoys.name: getBlockLobby
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the lobby settings of a single scrim block by its id, including the server region, map pool, and password. Use it when players need to join one scrim's lobby.

decoys.name: getBlockStats
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the match stats of a single scrim block by its id, including round scores, player ratings, and economy. Use it when the analyst reviews one scrim's performance.

decoys.name: getBlockVod
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the VOD recording of a single scrim block by its id, including the video link, timestamps, and review markers. Use it when the coach rewatches one scrim's footage.

list_parent.name: listPartnerOrgs
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every partner org the team has scrimmed against or arranged scrims with, along with their contact details. Use it to browse the team's regular scrim partners.

decoys.name: listLeagueOrgs
decoys.desc: This tool lists every org registered in the team's current league division, along with their contact details. Use it to browse the opponents on this split's league schedule.

decoys.name: listBlockedOrgs
decoys.desc: This tool lists every org on the team's scrim blocklist, along with their contact details. Use it to browse the teams the coaches have stopped practising with.

decoys.name: listAcademyOrgs
decoys.desc: This tool lists every org in the team's academy feeder network, along with their contact details. Use it to browse the development squads the org scouts players from.

get_parent.name: getOrgProfile
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches the profile of a single partner org by id, returning their contact details and team manager. Use it when staff need to reach one specific org.

decoys.name: getOrgRoster
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the active roster of a single partner org by id, returning their player handles and roles. Use it when staff need to scout one org's lineup.

decoys.name: getOrgHistory
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the head-to-head history of a single partner org by id, returning their wins and losses against the team. Use it when staff compare results against one org.

decoys.name: getOrgRating
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the partner rating of a single org by id, returning scores for punctuality and effort in past scrims. Use it when staff judge one org's reliability.

delete_child.name: purgeScrimBlock
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a scrim block from the org's practice calendar, and the action cannot be undone once submitted. Use it when a scrim was booked in error or has been replaced by another.

decoys.name: purgeScrimVod
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes the VOD recording of a scrim block from the team's storage, and the action cannot be undone once submitted. Use it when footage was uploaded to the wrong scrim or breaks an NDA.

decoys.name: purgeScrimStats
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes the stat export of a scrim block from the analytics dashboard, and the action cannot be undone once submitted. Use it when a tracker logged bad data for that scrim.

decoys.name: revokeScrimLobby
decoys.desc: This tool permanently revokes the lobby codes of a scrim block on the game server, and the action cannot be undone once submitted. Use it when the lobby password has leaked to outsiders.

set_enum.name: setLoggedState
set_enum.desc: This tool changes a scrim block's logged state between scheduled, played, and scrapped, tracking whether the practice actually happened. Use it once a scrim's outcome is known and needs recording.

decoys.name: setRequestedState
decoys.desc: This tool changes a scrim block's requested state between scheduled, played, and scrapped, tracking what the opposing org has asked for. Use it once the other team's manager sends a change request.

decoys.name: setLadderState
decoys.desc: This tool changes a scrim block's ladder state between scheduled, played, and scrapped, tracking what the public scrim ladder shows. Use it once the ladder listing needs to be brought up to date.

decoys.name: setPlannedState
decoys.desc: This tool changes a scrim block's planned state between scheduled, played, and scrapped, tracking what the coaching staff intend for the week. Use it once the weekly practice plan is drawn up.

set_bool.name: flagHighStakes
set_bool.desc: This tool marks a scrim block as high-stakes, flagging it as important practice ahead of a tournament. Use it when a scrim carries extra weight for roster evaluation or prep.

decoys.name: flagNdaBound
decoys.desc: This tool marks a scrim block as NDA-bound, flagging it as closed practice whose strats stay private. Use it when a scrim involves new comps being kept for a tournament.

decoys.name: flagTryoutScrim
decoys.desc: This tool marks a scrim block as a tryout, flagging it as practice where trial players fill roster spots. Use it when a scrim is used to evaluate new recruits.

decoys.name: flagStreamedScrim
decoys.desc: This tool marks a scrim block as streamed, flagging it as practice broadcast live on the org's channel. Use it when a scrim is part of a content day for sponsors.

set_ref.name: moveScrimOpponent
set_ref.desc: This tool moves a scrim block's opponent to a different org, carrying over its time and matchup details. Use it when a scrim was logged against the wrong org and needs correcting.

decoys.name: offerScrimSlot
decoys.desc: This tool offers a scrim block's time slot to a different org, sending them a booking request for the same window. Use it when the team wants a standby opponent lined up.

decoys.name: shareScrimVod
decoys.desc: This tool shares a scrim block's VOD with a different org, granting them access to the recording. Use it when the opposing team or a partner asks for the footage.

decoys.name: assignScrimHost
decoys.desc: This tool assigns a scrim block's hosting duty to a different org, making them responsible for the lobby and server. Use it when the other team has the better server region.

send.name: emailOrg
send.desc: This tool sends an email to a partner org, either about a specific scrim block or as a direct note. Use it to confirm scrim times or follow up after a session.

decoys.name: dmOrg
decoys.desc: This tool sends a Discord message to a partner org, either about a specific scrim block or as a direct note. Use it to ping the other team's manager during a session.
child_verbs: ping the org on {obj} on Discord

decoys.name: callOrg
decoys.desc: This tool starts a voice call with a partner org, either about a specific scrim block or as a direct check-in. Use it to talk through scheduling clashes quickly.
child_verbs: hop on a call with the org on {obj}

decoys.name: reportOrg
decoys.desc: This tool files a conduct report with a partner org, either about a specific scrim block or as a direct complaint. Use it when players were toxic or the lobby was left early.
child_verbs: file a conduct report with the org on {obj}

create.name: createScrimBlock
create.desc: This tool creates a new scrim block against an org, with an optional matchup and starting state. Use it when the team books a practice session with another org.

decoys.name: createShowMatch
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new show match against an org, with an optional matchup and starting state. Use it when the team arranges a streamed exhibition with another org.

decoys.name: createBootcampBlock
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new bootcamp block against an org, with an optional matchup and starting state. Use it when the team plans a multi-day practice camp with another org.

decoys.name: createLeagueFixture
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new league fixture against an org, with an optional matchup and starting state. Use it when the league assigns an official match with another org.

list_notes.name: listBlockNotes
list_notes.desc: This tool returns the notes attached to a single scrim block. It includes every remark players and coaches have logged against that scrim.

decoys.name: listBlockTakeaways
decoys.desc: This tool returns the coaching takeaways attached to a single scrim block. It includes every lesson the staff have drawn from that scrim.

decoys.name: listBlockIncidents
decoys.desc: This tool returns the incident reports attached to a single scrim block. It includes every disconnect, pause, or rules dispute logged in that scrim.

decoys.name: listBlockTimestamps
decoys.desc: This tool returns the VOD timestamps attached to a single scrim block. It includes every moment the analyst has marked for review in that scrim.

add_note.name: addBlockNote
add_note.desc: This tool attaches a new note to a scrim block, with an optional title. Use it to record remarks from players or coaches after a session.

decoys.name: addBlockTakeaway
decoys.desc: This tool attaches a new coaching takeaway to a scrim block, with an optional title. Use it to record a lesson the staff drew from a session.

decoys.name: addBlockIncident
decoys.desc: This tool attaches a new incident report to a scrim block, with an optional title. Use it to record a disconnect or rules dispute during a session.

decoys.name: addBlockTimestamp
decoys.desc: This tool attaches a new VOD timestamp to a scrim block, with an optional title. Use it to record a moment the analyst wants reviewed from a session.

update_note.name: editBlockNote
update_note.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a scrim block. Use it to correct or expand a remark after it was logged.

decoys.name: editBlockTakeaway
decoys.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing coaching takeaway on a scrim block. Use it to refine a lesson after the staff meeting.

decoys.name: editBlockIncident
decoys.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing incident report on a scrim block. Use it to add the outcome of a rules dispute.

decoys.name: editBlockTimestamp
decoys.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing VOD timestamp on a scrim block. Use it to relabel a moment after the review session.

delete_note.name: deleteBlockNote
delete_note.desc: This tool permanently deletes a note from a scrim block. The remark is erased from the practice log for good.

decoys.name: deleteBlockTakeaway
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes a coaching takeaway from a scrim block. The lesson is erased from the practice log for good.

decoys.name: deleteBlockIncident
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes an incident report from a scrim block. The report is erased from the practice log for good.

decoys.name: deleteBlockTimestamp
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes a VOD timestamp from a scrim block. The marker is erased from the practice log for good.

set_image.name: setBlockImage
set_image.desc: This tool sets the image shown on a scrim block. It is typically a matchup graphic made by the org's content team.

decoys.name: setBlockScoreboard
decoys.desc: This tool sets the scoreboard screenshot shown on a scrim block. It is typically the end-of-match results screen captured by a player.

decoys.name: setBlockMapview
decoys.desc: This tool sets the map overview shown on a scrim block. It is typically the minimap with the team's setups marked by the analyst.

decoys.name: setBlockThumbnail
decoys.desc: This tool sets the VOD thumbnail shown on a scrim block. It is typically the frame chosen by the video editor for the upload.

writer.name: writeShortMessage
writer.desc: This tool writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the scrim blocks it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writeScrimReport
decoys.desc: This tool writes a scrim report from a brief, which states the takeaways in the coach's own words, and the scrim blocks it should cover. It returns the finished report.

decoys.name: writeSocialPost
decoys.desc: This tool writes a social media post from a brief, which states the angle in the content lead's own words, and the scrim blocks it should feature. It returns the finished post.

decoys.name: writePrepDoc
decoys.desc: This tool writes an opponent prep doc from a brief, which states the tendencies in the analyst's own words, and the scrim blocks it should draw on. It returns the finished doc.

image.name: generateImage
image.desc: This tool generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generateClip
decoys.desc: This tool generates a short highlight clip from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: findArtwork
decoys.desc: This tool finds matching artwork in the content team's asset library for a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the match.

decoys.name: generateStinger
decoys.desc: This tool generates a stream transition stinger from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

search.name: searchHelpDocs
search.desc: This tool searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the org's tools work.

decoys.name: searchLeagueRulebook
decoys.desc: This tool searches the league rulebook with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a match rule or penalty.

decoys.name: searchPatchNotes
decoys.desc: This tool searches the game patch notes with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up what changed in the latest update.

decoys.name: searchStratBook
decoys.desc: This tool searches the team strat book with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a set play or map setup.
